acceptanceCriteria: Step-IR sequences across tests cluster into candidate flows (start screen, steps, end screen/outcome) and variations, each citing its source tests; candidates are proposals, never accepted intent (invariant 8).
Joins test-knowledge trust levels (PR #1165) so run+reviewed tests outrank unreviewed ones.
Step sequences are mined from tests (today AFU intents are authored and `flows import` writes proposed intents only); mined flows enter as proposed intents through the same path.
body: Owner goal (2026-10-19): from an app's existing tests, learn every page object, link/navigation, data setup and the step sequences that do anything in the site; then 'show me how to do X' builds an e2e test that demonstrates X, proven by a live run, or abstains naming what is missing. Inventory at origin/main 6ceee260b: appmap screens/page-object bindings (AMAP-V0), navigation ledger (ANL-V0), flows (AFU-V1), legacy discovery/crosswalk (DCP-V1-060..069), test-knowledge (DCP-V1-086..092, PR #1165), AMSP draft planner, CCE compile/prove (partly unbuilt), NEA/RVN/PWP/TSA validation pieces exist but are not chained. Flows are human-authored (AFU-V1); nothing clusters learned step sequences into reusable flows.
title: Site knowledge 5: infer flows and variations from existing test step sequences
